blocks.summary: Since you're craving a delicate, melt-in-mouth tofu dish with fine threads in a clear soy broth, these refined Chinese spots in Bengaluru are your best bet for authentic Jiangsu-style preparations — perfect for a late-night, sophisticated meal.

cards.title: Shang Palace, Vasanth Nagar
cards.why: Authentic Guangdong & Sichuan cuisine; tofu dishes like Mapo Tofu and Sichuan Pepper Tofu are brilliant and unaltered for Indian palates.

cards.title: Garden Asia Restaurant, Koramangala
cards.why: Known for delicate soups and tofu preparations; Chicken Wonton Soup and mocktails in a peaceful, late-night friendly ambiance.

cards.title: China Pearl, Koramangala
cards.why: Traditional Hakka cuisine with generous portions; vegetarian-friendly with consistent, authentic flavours.

cards.title: Chowman, Indiranagar
cards.why: Modern Chinese with spicy, fresh preparations; open till midnight on weekends for late-night dining.
